description: This Java source file defines the TransportRequestHandler class, which processes various network requests in Apache Spark's network server module. It handles stream requests, RPC calls, stream uploads, and meta requests, managing communication over a Netty channel.

classes.name: TransportRequestHandler
classes.description: Handles client requests over a Netty channel, including stream fetches, RPCs, stream uploads, and meta requests, with connection management and error handling.

methods.name: TransportRequestHandler
methods.description: Constructor initializing the handler with channel, client, RPC handler, max chunks, and fetch request handler.

methods.name: exceptionCaught
methods.description: Handles exceptions caught during channel operations, delegating to rpcHandler.

methods.name: channelActive
methods.description: Invoked when the channel becomes active, notifying rpcHandler.

methods.name: channelInactive
methods.description: Invoked when the channel becomes inactive, cleans up streams and notifies rpcHandler.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Main request dispatcher that processes different request types: fetch, RPC, stream, upload, and meta.

methods.name: processStreamRequest
methods.description: Handles stream fetch requests, manages chunk limits, opens streams, and responds with stream data or failure.

methods.name: processRpcRequest
methods.description: Processes RPC requests, invoking rpcHandler and responding with success or failure.

methods.name: processStreamUpload
methods.description: Handles client stream uploads, setting up callbacks, interceptors, and error handling.

methods.name: processMergedBlockMetaRequest
methods.description: Handles merged block meta requests, invoking rpcHandler and responding accordingly.

methods.name: respond
methods.description: Sends a response message over the channel, logging success or failure, and closing the channel on error.
